# Prism x86 (Win32) build

This is a 32-bit build of `prism.dll`, compiled locally from upstream source. Upstream ships no x86 release asset. It is meant for loading into 32-bit game processes. The x64 dll in the parent directory is the unmodified upstream release asset.

## 1. Source

- Upstream: https://github.com/ethindp/prism
- Tag: `v0.16.6`
- Commit: `655fb40be0844b4dd15ba0aa0b3f48972fe50160`
- The source tree was unmodified: no patches.

### 1.1 Why v0.16.6

- `../prism.h` is byte-identical (ignoring line endings) to `include/prism.h` at every tag from v0.16.0 to v0.16.7. It differs from v0.17.0 and later.
- `../prism.dll` (SHA256 `86aa3c8ae40eecb59dee070fc2f4c1adcf9944d6563a293496a5645d7d1569dc`) is byte-identical to `dynamic/release/bin/prism.dll` in the upstream `prism-windows-x64.zip` asset of release v0.16.6. That makes v0.16.6 the exact version of the vendored x64 build.

## 2. Toolchain

- Visual Studio Community 2026, v18.9.3 (`C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\Community`)
- MSVC toolset 14.51.36231. Compiler: `cl` 19.51.36257, targeting x86 (host x64, `vcvarsall amd64_x86`)
- Windows SDK 10.0.26100.0 (midl, rc, mt)
- CMake 4.3.1-msvc1 and Ninja 1.13.2, both bundled with VS under `Common7\IDE\CommonExtensions\Microsoft\CMake`

## 3. Commands

The configure options match upstream's `.github/workflows/build-windows.yml` (Ninja, Release, shared) with two differences: shims are off, because tolk.dll is not needed, and the CRT is set explicitly.

The scratchpad build path was too deep for MAX_PATH. The object file for `web_speech_synthesis_backend.cpp` failed with `C1083 Cannot open compiler generated file`. To get around this, the build folder was mapped to a drive letter with `subst` for the duration of the build. `<build-root>` below is the folder holding the `src` checkout.

```bat
subst P: "<build-root>"
call "C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\Community\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvarsall.bat" amd64_x86
set "VSCM=C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\Community\Common7\IDE\CommonExtensions\Microsoft\CMake"
set "PATH=%VSCM%\CMake\bin;%VSCM%\Ninja;%PATH%"
cd /d P:\src
cmake -B P:\b86 -G Ninja -DPRISM_ENABLE_TESTS=OFF -DPRISM_ENABLE_DEMOS=OFF -DPRISM_ENABLE_SHIMS=OFF -DPRISM_ENABLE_LEGACY_BACKENDS=ON -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON -DPRISM_ENABLE_GDEXTENSION=OFF -DCMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY=MultiThreaded
cmake --build P:\b86
subst P: /d
```

Get the source with `git clone https://github.com/ethindp/prism src` followed by `git -C src checkout v0.16.6`. Set `git config core.longpaths true` first, because the default branch has paths that are too long for a plain checkout on Windows.

## 4. CRT linkage

The CRT is linked statically (`/MT`, `CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY=MultiThreaded`). This is also what upstream's CMakeLists picks by default for non-Debug builds when `PRISM_ENABLE_GDEXTENSION=OFF`. The dll does not import `VCRUNTIME140.dll`, `MSVCP140.dll` or `ucrtbase.dll`, so no VC++ redistributable is needed.

## 5. Verification

The checks below used `dumpbin` from the same toolset.

- PE machine is `0x14C` (x86), "32 bit word machine".
- There are 42 exports. They match exactly the 42 `prism_*` functions declared in `../prism.h`, with nothing missing and nothing extra. They are also identical to the export list of the vendored x64 dll.
- All export names are plain and undecorated: no `_name@N` stdcall decoration, no leading underscore, no C++ mangling. The header declares every function with `PRISM_CALL` = `__cdecl`.
- Regular dependencies are all OS components, the same set as the x64 build: KERNEL32, ole32, OLEAUT32, USER32, RPCRT4, SHLWAPI, XmlLite, UIAutomationCore, ADVAPI32, api-ms-win-core-synch-l1-2-0, api-ms-win-core-winrt-error-l1-1-1 and api-ms-win-core-winrt-l1-1-0.
- Delay-loaded dependencies are loaded only if the matching screen reader is present: ZDSRAPI.dll, byctrl.dll, PCTKUSR.dll, prism_orca_bridge.dll and prism_speech_dispatcher_bridge.dll. These are the 32-bit names; the x64 build uses ZDSRAPI_x64.dll and byctrl-x64.dll instead.
- The NVDA controller RPC stub was generated by MIDL with `/env win32`.
- The compiler gave one warning: C4244 in `sapi.cpp` `get_voice`, where a `uint64_t` voice index is narrowed to 32-bit `size_t`. This is harmless.
